Our story

The road starts here.

What began in a remodeled farmhouse has grown into five buildings on a beautiful six-acre campus — with the same steadfast love for children and learning.

  • Feels like Grandma’s house

    Mrs. Cindy founded Little Bears in 1987 so children would feel cherished — and parents could head to work with peace of mind.

  • Six acres to explore

    Soccer fields, basketball goals, sandboxes, multiple playgrounds and hands-on garden projects.

  • A big family of families

    Many Little Bears today have parents who toddled these same halls. Graduates still stop by to reminisce.

  • Learning that feels like adventure

    Social, emotional, physical and academic growth — with science, stories, outdoor play and kindergarten readiness.

FAQ

Questions parents ask first

What ages do you serve?

We care for infants and toddlers, preschoolers ages 3–5, and school-age children ages 5–12 with before- and after-school care plus break camps.

What are your hours?

We are open Monday through Friday, 6:30 AM to 6:00 PM.

How much is tuition?

Weekly preschool tuition (including breakfast, lunch and afternoon snack) is $230 for 2-year-olds, $225 for 3-year-olds ($230 if not potty trained), and $220 for 4-year-olds ($230 if not potty trained). There is a $100 registration fee and a $75 yearly book fee. School-age before care is $75/week, after care $95/week, both $105/week, and summer camp is $180/week.

Do meals come with tuition?

Yes for preschool programs: breakfast, lunch and an afternoon snack are included. The weekly menu is posted in the front lobby. Summer camp includes breakfast and snacks; please send a sack lunch.

Can I tour the campus?

Yes. Drop by for a tour, meet the staff and pick up an enrollment packet. You can also request a tour with the form on this page or by calling (901) 373-8687.

Where are you located?

6975 US-70, Bartlett, TN 38133, on a six-acre campus with five buildings designed by age group.

Are you licensed?

Yes. Little Bears is a state-certified / licensed Tennessee child care center. Public directories list us as licensed since July 7, 1988. Ask us for our current DHS record, or look us up on the Tennessee Child Care Locator.

What makes Little Bears different?

We started in 1987 with Mrs. Cindy’s vision of a place that feels like Grandma’s house — warm, loving and educational — on six acres with five age-specific buildings. Many families are second-generation Little Bears.
